run_cli_create_aws_iam_user: run the CLI to create an AWS IAM user with --add_iam_user and --user_name flags
run_cli_create_aws_iam_policy: run the CLI to create an AWS IAM policy with --add_iam_policy and --policy_name flags
run_cli_attach_iam_policy: run the CLI to attach an IAM policy to a user with --attach_iam_policy flags
run_cli_destroy_aws_iam_user: run the CLI to destroy an AWS IAM user with --delete_iam_user and --user_name flags
run_cli_destroy_aws_iam_policy: run the CLI to destroy an AWS IAM policy with --delete_iam_policy and --policy_name flags
